source_text: Within Jewish communities, a minority of activists, including groups promoting Brit Shalom—a non-surgical naming ceremony as an alternative "covenant of peace"—challenge brit milah as an archaic custom incompatible with modern ethics, arguing it contravenes Jewish values of pikuach nefesh (saving life) when risks are weighed against unproven benefits. [136] [137]
